question: Does the exact positive-median policyPackageOrder grammar have enough measured repertoire decision value on the frozen root-550 evidence to justify any new simulator row?
correctionBoundary: Revision 1 stopped before any estimand at its first rectangle-validation call because that frozen helper was referenced from the importing module rather than post_v38_heldout_confirmation. Revision 2 changes only those three module references and the immutable runner, protocol and summary paths. Evidence, thresholds, design, estimands, gates, budgets, decisions and stopping rules are byte-for-byte inherited otherwise.
retrospectiveScope: This is a declared retrospective, zero-new-row reuse of the immutable package-order held-out rectangle. It is a necessary method-value screen, not a causal estimate of the unexecuted mixed grammar. The no-interference splice may authorise a new CRN experiment but cannot admit a package, detector or product result.

designMatrix.rows: Reuse only the complete root-550 sampled-policy rows from the frozen same-content universal structural candidate and packageOrder-null arms. RandomBuild and live-baseline rows are not needed for this repertoire-only screen.
designMatrix.eligibility: For each policy identity and package separately, eligible means the resolved registered payoff preference is greater than or equal to its exact sample-origin median. Scoreline, Afterimage, Bloodfire and Poison remain separate factors.
designMatrix.noInterferenceSplice: For a package, use its observed universal-candidate activation state on eligible identities and its observed structural-null activation state on ineligible identities. This is a deterministic descriptive splice, not an unobserved endpoint claim.
designMatrix.observedEndpointSelectionBound: The intersection of universal-candidate and structural-null active sets is active under every per-policy selection between those two observed endpoint states. Therefore 128 minus that intersection is the maximum inactive count available without a new cross-package interference effect.
designMatrix.functionalSeparation: Apply the frozen within-aspect exclusive-policy gate to the four no-interference splice sets.
designMatrix.aliasStructure: No simulator cell, fitted threshold, alternative sign, package-specific retune or joint-interference assumption is introduced. A failed splice cannot be rescued by assuming an unmeasured cross-package effect.

estimands.eligibilityBalance: Eligible and ineligible policy counts for each separate package preference.
estimands.observedUniversalMovement: Universal candidate gains and losses relative to structural null, split by package eligibility.
estimands.noInterferenceSensitivity: Active and inactive counts after the preregistered candidate-if-eligible, null-if-ineligible splice.
estimands.noInterferenceFunctionalSeparation: Within-aspect package-only counts under those splice activation sets.
estimands.endpointSelectionCapacity: Maximum inactive count obtainable by selecting, per policy, between the two observed candidate/null activation endpoints.

decisionRules.success: Every package has at least 32 eligible and 32 ineligible policies; every no-interference splice has at least 32 active and 32 inactive policies; both aspects retain at least eight package-only policies in each direction; and every observed-endpoint selection capacity can meet the inactive minimum.
decisionRules.futility: Any eligibility, sensitivity, functional-separation or observed-endpoint capacity gate fails.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any immutable evidence, policy identity, complete-rectangle, ledger-integrity or exact-hash assertion fails before the deterministic audit result.
decisionRules.successAuthority: The exact positive-median grammar has measured decision value for one separately preregistered mechanism-blocked CRN experiment. This does not authorise changed thresholds, ML/RL, detector admission, product promotion or protected seeds.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the positive-median policyPackageOrder grammar without a simulator row. Do not assume beneficial cross-package interference or retune its sign or thresholds; continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record no decision and run no simulator row until the immutable evidence fault is resolved.

stoppingRule: Run the fixed read-only audit once. Take boundary 1 only if every decision-value gate passes; otherwise take boundary 2 and close this exact grammar. No optional calculation, threshold change, cohort change, simulator row or rerun exists.
